schema_objects.name: assessment_guard_truncate
schema_objects.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assessment_guard_truncate()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
        BEGIN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Assessment history cannot be truncated' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
        END;
        $function$

schema_objects.name: assessment_exercise_skill_truncate_guard
schema_objects.definition: CREATE TRIGGER assessment_exercise_skill_truncate_guard BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.assessment_exercise_skill FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION assessment_guard_truncate()
